items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VIII, List of Answers on Topics 32:1
items.html: The Mochin fixed in Atik, Arich Anpin, and Aba and Ima of Atzilut were corrected from the second division of Nekudim, where the correction was only in the heads alone, which are regarded as the phase of the Ketarim; but the nine lower Sefirot of Nekudim, namely the bodies in them, came out only from the third division, as is known. Accordingly, it is found that all the Nefesh, Ruach, Neshama, Haya, Yechida of Atzilut are the Nefesh, Ruach, Neshama, Haya, Yechida of Keter alone, and they lack the nine lower Sefirot in comparison to Nekudim. (Inner Light, page 684, Sub Header, “And With This”)
